source_title: Bushfire catches Nowra residents off guard, as NSW RFS warns of dangerous conditions (ABC News)
quote: The Nowra fire was one of three blazes in New South Wales that was threatening properties, although no homes were destroyed.
match_note: Covers the Nowra (West Cambewarra Rd, North Nowra) and Ulladulla (Kingiman / Croobyar Rd) fires of 15-16 Aug 2018, both inside Shoalhaven LGA and both in agrn 818. The 'three blazes' also included Yankees Gap (Bega Valley), where 2 houses were confirmed later the same day, so this early statement is only trusted for the Shoalhaven fires because the same-day RFS building impact list (next row) shows no house destroyed at Kingiman or North Nowra. Lower bound for the event: later small fires in 818 (Jerrawangala Nov 2018 / Jan 2019, Termeil) not checked. Consistent with RFS 2018/19 season budget (see SEASON rows: at most 1 home unaccounted for statewide outside Tingha/Bruxner/Yankees Gap).

source_title: Bega Valley fire destroys two houses, RFS says (ABC News)

match_note: North Nowra fire (West Cambewarra Rd, 96 ha) in agrn 818. Same article, RFS assessment for Mount Kingiman (west of Ulladulla): 11 outbuildings destroyed and 1 damaged, no house listed; North Nowra also 1 outbuilding destroyed, 1 damaged. So Shoalhaven = 0 homes destroyed, 1 damaged on the RFS first-pass BIA. Dataset already has homes_damaged=1 for this row.

source_title: Bush Fire Bulletin Vol 41 No 2 (2019), 'Winter fires ravage northern NSW'
quote: By the end of the week, four homes and nine outbuildings had been destroyed.
match_note: Preceding sentence: warnings were issued for fires burning in the Kempsey, Clarence Valley and Richmond Valley areas over the weekend of 10-11 Aug 2019. ABC 14 Aug 2019 gives the location of all four homes: Rappville x2 (Richmond Valley) and Turners Flat + Gilmores Gully (Kempsey area). Covers the July - mid-Aug part of agrn 880 only.
